t: $(thing)Ethanol/$ can be produced in a $(l:manufacturing/thermopneumatic_processing_plant)Thermopneumatic Processing Plant/$ with $(l:renewables/yeast_culture)Yeast Culture/$ and $(thing)Sugar/$. It is one of the constituents of $(l:renewables/biodiesel)Biodiesel/$.
$(thing)乙醇/$可以在$(l:manufacturing/thermopneumatic_processing_plant)热气动加工机/$中使用$(l:renewables/yeast_culture)酵母菌/$和$(thing)砂糖/$生产。它是$(l:renewables/biodiesel)生物柴油/$的成分之一。

This process is temperature-sensitive: you will need to keep the Thermopneumatic Processing Plant's temperature between 30°C and 60°C.$(p)This is very easy in warmer biomes but may take a little effort in cooler areas - one thing to note is that the ambient temperature tend to rise as you dig deeper, so temperate biomes might be suitable if do your processing at a lower Y-level.
这个过程对温度很敏感：你需要将热气动加工机的温度保持在 30°C 到 60°C 之间。$(p)在温暖的生物群系中，这很容易做到；但在较冷的地区，可能就需要花一点工夫了——需要注意的一点是，随着你向下挖掘，环境温度往往会上升，因此如果你在更低的 Y 轴高度进行加工，温带生物群落也可能很适合。
